'''Indo Zal's father''' was a decorated [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Knights of Zakuul|Knight of Zakuul]] who [[Death/Legends|died]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] at the [[Battle of Scyva]]. He had two children, [[Indo Zal]] and [[Kalya Zal]] with his [[Indo Zal's mother|partner]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Indo Zal}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Indo Zal's father is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' in Indo Zal's Codex entry.
